title: Use the PCH dummy-string headers, never hand copies
summary: Translation units that need the retail dummy strings include <System/DummyStrings.hpp> or <M3DUtil/InfectiousStrings.hpp>; they do not redefine dummyMactorStringValue1, SMS_NO_MEMORY_MESSAGE or MtxCalcTypeName, copy their literals under other names, or predefine the header guards to suppress the include.
The upstream static void dummy(Vec*) .rodata emission helper is accepted only with a // dummy: emits <symbols> comment naming the anonymous objects it produces in this unit.
This is the SMS exception to no-inert-emission and to the guard-predefine rule in no-symbol-forgery.
provenance: Accepted 2026-09-16 with implemented lint rules; see audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/REPORT.md Part 4. Owns PCH guard-predefine findings in SMS: the sms_baseline post-scan hook drops the global header_override_macro finding on a line where sms_pch_string_convention reported a guard predefine.
preferred_repairs:
// dummy: emits lit_4321, lit_4322
static void dummy(Vec* v) { *v = (Vec) { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f }; }
do: Include the owning header when the target object carries the dummy strings.
Name the emitted .rodata symbols next to a dummy(Vec*) helper so the reviewer can check them against the map.
do_not: Copy the dummy-string literals into a .cpp under any name or storage class.
Predefine SYSTEM_DUMMY_STRINGS_HPP or M3DUTIL_INFECTIOUS_STRINGS_HPP to change what the include emits.
Add a dummy(Vec*) helper without the evidence comment; a helper missing the comment is flagged for review, not rejected.

title: No fabricated scaffolding; markers are not an exemption
summary: SMS autonomous output does not add #pragma dont_inline / inline_depth, fabricated single-use static inline helpers or hand-expanded header inline bodies. Each is rejected whether or not a // fabricated, // fake, // fakematch or // TODO comment sits next to it.

Upstream AGENTS.md lets humans keep marked fakematch scaffolding; SMS maintainers do not accept it from AI: no agent TODOs, and choosing inlines to force the frame size is banned for AI. Leave the function nonmatching instead, with no comment.
Markers do not downgrade global findings either: codegen_pragma, novel_pragma, single_use_wrapper and discarded_expression keep their unmarked severity in SMS.
provenance: Accepted 2026-09-16 with implemented lint rules; see audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/REPORT.md Part 4. Owns SMS pragma marking policy (pragma bullet moved here from sms-temporary-tactics on 2026-09-16): the sms_baseline post-scan hook drops global codegen_pragma and novel_pragma findings on lines where sms_fabricated_marker reported a pragma, and on the closing #pragma dont_inline off that the SMS rule deliberately accepts. force_active stays an error under the global avoid-pragmas-register-asm record. Rewritten 2026-10-13 for the SMS maintainer ruling (Mrkol, Discord, 2026-10-13) and doldecomp/sms #330/#331: markers no longer downgrade SMS or global findings.
do: Recognize the real inline from headers, mario.MAP and sibling decomps.
Leave the function nonmatching, with no comment, when the inline cannot be identified.
do_not: Commit dont_inline or inline_depth pragmas, single-use static inline helpers or hand-expanded header inline bodies, marked or not.
Add a // fabricated, // fake, // fakematch or // TODO comment to keep scaffolding.
Use #pragma force_active to keep unreferenced data alive.

title: No agent-written comments in source
summary: Do not add TODO, FIXME, nonmatching, fakematch, fabricated, frame-only, stack-size, regalloc or objdiff notes to SMS source. Maintainers reject them as useless and perpetually out of date ("no clanker TODOs", doldecomp/sms #331).
A function that does not match stays nonmatching without a note; report remaining differences in the attempt summary.
Struct offset comments (/* 0x10 */), _pad member names and comments the code already carried are not agent notes.
do: Delete every comment you wrote about matching state, tactics or the frame before submitting.
Put remaining differences and hypotheses in the attempt summary.
do_not: Write // TODO: nonmatching, // fakematch, // frame-only mismatch or an objdiff percentage in source.
Rephrase a matching note to avoid the lint.
provenance: Added 2026-10-13 from doldecomp/sms #331 review (lensflare, lensglow) and the SMS maintainer ruling (Mrkol, Discord, 2026-10-13).

title: Accessors and inline swaps need evidence they exist
summary: Replace a direct member access with an accessor (mModel-> to getModel()->), route a call through another inline (getColorChan(i) to getColorBlock()->getColorChan(i)) or add a new inline to a header only with evidence that the accessor or inline exists in the original: an upstream header, the symbol map (mario.MAP, symbols.txt) or a sibling decomp using it at the same call site.
Swapping inlines to make the frame size fit is a fakematch (doldecomp/sms #330). A frame-size, stack-layout or match-percent gain is not evidence.
Accessors backed by evidence stay: TSunMgr::load using getPosition() was flagged and then retracted by the maintainer ("wrong inline, this one is correct").
do: Name the header, map symbol or sibling decomp line that shows the accessor in the attempt summary when you keep a swap.
Keep the upstream expression when there is no such evidence.
do_not: Swap mModel-> for getModel()-> or add a getColorBlock()-> hop to change the frame or the score.
Invent a new inline accessor in a header to explain codegen.
provenance: Added 2026-10-13 from doldecomp/sms #330 (MActor setModel, SampleCtrlNode ctor) and #331 (sunmgr retraction). Generalizes the getUnkNN()/unkNN flip that sms_intrinsic_bypass used to own.

title: New pragmas, register steering, and inline assembly are not allowed in normal source
summary: Pragmas, register keywords and inline assembly are banned in normal decomp source; source that adds them is rejected.
SMS autonomous output has no pragma exception: dont_inline, inline_depth and force_active are rejected outright (sms-fabricated-marker), and any other codegen pragma is an error.
A TODO or fabricated marker next to a pragma does not downgrade the finding in SMS.
This SMS record replaces the global pragma record for SMS workers.
do: Remove pragma, register and inline-assembly steering; leave the function nonmatching, with no comment, when clean source does not match.
do_not: Add #pragma global_optimizer off, dont_inline, inline_depth or any other codegen pragma.
Mark a pragma with // TODO or // fabricated to keep it.
Use inline assembly outside SDK-like code while reasonable C alternatives remain.
preferred_repairs: Remove register, inline asm and pragma steering from normal source.
Recover or restore the C implementation; leave the function nonmatching when it does not match.
provenance: SMS override of the global record (same id; the SMS slice wins for SMS workers). Written 2026-10-13 for the SMS maintainer ruling (Mrkol, Discord, 2026-10-13): no marked-pragma exception in SMS.

title: Literals stay inline, data ownership needs evidence, and extern in a .c file is banned
summary: Promoting a string, float, or constant into named storage because generated output exposed an address is not allowed; source that keeps such an invented symbol is rejected.

String literals used as asset names, resource labels, assert/report text, and table labels stay inline; replacing one with a generated or global data symbol is a data regression unless maintainer-approved data-ownership evidence explicitly scopes the change as data work. Packed blobs and pointer offsets into them used as a matching dodge are rejected.
An extern declaration in a .c file is banned outright: declare the symbol in its owning header or define the data in this translation unit.

The only permitted named-data case is recorded section-ownership evidence (.data, .rodata, .sdata, .sdata2, .sbss metadata, symbol size/scope, local labels, or split boundaries); section placement is match evidence, and wrong metadata is fixed rather than compensated for with fake C storage.
A section-target change must name the map symbol or consuming function that owns the data it moves, and a section-only acceptance may not regress any function.

Do not add data-ordering helpers (order_sdata2 or any *_order function) or inert emissions to force .sdata2/.rodata/.data order. Leave a data-order mismatch nonmatching, with no comment, unless upstream code or the symbol map shows the original had that helper.
This SMS record replaces the global literals-and-data-ownership record for SMS workers.
do: Keep constants, strings, and float literals inline; named data is required to carry recorded section-ownership or symbol metadata as evidence.
Keep asset names, table labels, assert/report text, and resource names inline; a string-literal-to-symbol change is accepted only as scoped data-ownership work backed by recorded evidence.
Verify .data, .rodata, .sdata, .sdata2, and .sbss ownership before naming any data; unverified naming is rejected.
Fix symbol size, type, scope, or local labels in the project's symbol metadata when the metadata is wrong; use assert filenames, object names, strings, and float groups as TU split evidence.
Name the owning map symbol or consuming function for every section-target change, and land the code match that leaves the literal in place whenever the alternative only relocates a data section.
Declare any needed symbol in its owning header or define the data in this TU; an extern in a .c file is never accepted.
do_not: Create static literals or globals to force data order; such source is rejected.
Replace ordinary numeric literals such as 0.0F, 1.0F, or -F32_MAX with TU-local address-named symbols for relocation or data-order pressure.
Replace an asset label or report string with an address-named symbol, or serve it from a packed blob plus offset, to chase data parity.
Add fake data anchors or dummy C storage to compensate for bad symbol metadata; these are hard failures, not style.
Move literals or data across translation units without split evidence.
Accept a section-only change that regresses a function, or treat section placement as cosmetic.
Add an order_sdata2 or other ordering helper to anchor float or string order.
evidence_refs: user-provided review comment: Replacing the string with the variable is a regression.
qa_enforcement: hard_lint; extern_in_c and extern_own_tu_data lint .c only
preferred_repairs: Keep literals inline; named data ownership is accepted only with recorded section ownership, symbol metadata, or surrounding-source evidence.
Fix symbol/split metadata instead of adding fake C storage to chase data order.
Replace address-named float statics such as un_804DDF74 with inline literals like 0.0f or 7.0f; keep the symbol only when data ownership is proven.
Keep asset names, table labels, assert text, and report text inline; recover real string tables only with ownership evidence.
Leave a remaining .sdata2/.rodata order mismatch nonmatching, with no comment.
provenance: SMS override of the global record (same id; the SMS slice wins for SMS workers). Written 2026-10-13: SMS upstream has no data-ordering helper (no order_sdata2, sdata2_order or *_order() in src/include), so the global @todo-marked order_sdata2 allowance does not apply.

title: Do not add inert statements or data to steer section bytes
summary: Discarded literals (`(void)1.0f;`, `"<TFoo>";`), pure calls whose result is dropped (`strcmp(name, "x");`), `(void)x.member;`, unreferenced file-scope static data, and uncalled static functions do no work; they exist only to emit bytes into .rodata/.sdata/.data. Source that adds them is rejected.

Do not add data-ordering helpers (order_sdata2 or any *_order function) or inert emissions to force .sdata2/.rodata/.data order. Leave a data-order mismatch nonmatching, with no comment, unless upstream code or the symbol map shows the original had that helper.
The one SMS exception is the upstream static void dummy(Vec*) .rodata emission idiom with its // dummy: emits <symbols> comment (sms-pch-string-convention); it is upstream code, not an agent helper.
This SMS record replaces the global no-inert-emission record for SMS workers.
provenance: SMS override of the global record (same id; the SMS slice wins for SMS workers). Written 2026-10-13: SMS upstream has no data-ordering helper (no order_sdata2, sdata2_order or *_order() in src/include), so the global @todo-marked order_sdata2 allowance does not apply.
do: Recover the code that consumes the literal, string, or data; the bytes follow from real use.
Delete static data and functions nothing references.
Leave a data-order mismatch nonmatching, with no comment, when the consumer cannot be recovered.
do_not: Emit constructor labels or strings through discarded `strcmp`/string statements in factory branches.
Cast literals to void in ordinary function bodies to reserve constant-pool slots.
Add `static const` tables or scalars that no code in the unit reads, or keep `force_active` pragmas to retain them.
Add an order_sdata2 helper, (void) literal anchors or any other inert ordering function, marked or not.
preferred_repairs: Replace each discarded statement with the real consumer, or remove it and accept the section gap.
Remove unreferenced static data; if the map proves the unit owns it, recover its user.
